mapper.sql: select c.comment_id, c.review_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_id, c.user_id, c.shop_id, c.user_type, c.comment_type, c.content, c.images, c.like_count, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.is_deleted from tb_product_comment c
mapper.insert: insert into tb_product_comment ( review_id, parent_id, reply_to_id, user_id, shop_id, user_type, comment_type, content, images, like_count, status, create_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{reviewId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToId}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{userType}, #{commentType}, #{content}, #{images}, #{likeCount}, #{status}, sysdate(), 0 )
mapper.update: update tb_product_comment set like_count = ifnull(like_count,0) + #{delta} where comment_id = #{commentId} and is_deleted = 0
